title: Email Cleaner: one item per address
description: The cleaned address with a status, the reasons, and the checks behind it.

input.title: Input
input.description: The line exactly as it came in.

email.title: Email
email.description: The cleaned address: surrounding junk removed and the domain in lower case. Empty when the line holds no @.

status.title: Status
status.description: valid: the domain takes mail and nothing about the address looks wrong. risky: it takes mail but the address is disposable, a role account, a likely typo or reachable only through an A record. invalid: bad syntax, junk, no such domain, a null MX or no mail host. unknown: the DNS lookup did not finish (never charged). Never says the mailbox exists.

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Why the status is what it is, for example disposable, role_account, did_you_mean, a_record_fallback, domain_not_found, null_mx, invalid_syntax, junk_file_name, dns_timeout. Empty for a clean valid address.

fixed_from.title: Fixed from
fixed_from.description: The raw line, when cleaning changed it (for example mailto:Info@Gmail.COM). Empty when the line was already clean.

junk.title: Junk type
junk.description: file_name for asset names read as addresses (logo@2x.png), tracking_id for machine ids (abc123@sentry.io), placeholder for fill-in addresses (name@example.com). Empty for a real-looking address.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain part of the address, lower case, in ASCII form for an international domain.

accepts_mail.title: Accepts mail
accepts_mail.description: True when the domain has a mail server (or an address record to fall back on), false when it has none, empty when it was not looked up or the lookup did not finish.

mx_null.title: Null MX
mx_null.description: True when the domain publishes a null MX (RFC 7505), which says it accepts no mail at all.

mx_provider.title: Mail provider
mx_provider.description: Who runs the mail of the domain, read from its MX names: google, microsoft, zoho, proofpoint, mimecast, yahoo, icloud, proton, and more. other when the MX is not one we know, none when the domain has no MX, empty when it was not looked up.

disposable.title: Disposable domain
disposable.description: True when the domain, or a parent of it, is on the public list of disposable and throwaway mail services.

role.title: Role account
role.description: True for shared mailboxes such as info@, sales@, support@, admin@ or noreply@.

free_provider.title: Free provider
free_provider.description: True for a free mailbox provider such as Gmail, Outlook or Yahoo.

did_you_mean.title: Did you mean
did_you_mean.description: A corrected address when the domain looks like a typo of a popular one (gmial.com for gmail.com) or has a mistyped ending (.con for .com).

duplicate_of.title: Duplicate of
duplicate_of.description: With Remove duplicates off: the first input line that held the same address. Empty otherwise.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per address: the line as it came in, the cleaned address, its status and reasons, and the domain checks.
